commands.title: Find file
commands.description: Fuzzy-find files by path across the workspace folders, honoring .gitignore. Returns {matches:[{path, absPath, positions, line?}], truncated, capped, indexing?}; positions are rune indexes of the matched characters in path, and a query ending in :N matches without the suffix and puts line N on every match.

query.description: Fuzzy query matched against workspace-relative paths, case-insensitively; empty lists the shortest paths.

capped.description: The workspace has more files than the 200000-path index cap; the rest are not searched.

indexing.description: The first index of the workspace is still being built; matches is empty, retry shortly.

commands.title: Search workspace
commands.description: Searches the workspace's agent sessions (agents.search), backlog tasks (backlog.list), wiki pages (wiki.search) and docs (docs.list, name or relative path, any case) at once. Returns {groups:[{id, title, total, items:[{kind, id, title, line, target}]}], errors?:[{id, error}]} in the order sessions, tasks, wiki, docs; a group with no match is left out, a source that is missing or fails is left out and named in errors. A number query puts that task first.

query.description: Text to find; empty returns no groups.

limit.description: Items per group; total still counts every match.

group.description: Return only this group with every match.

groups.description: Each group also has items: [{kind, id, title, line, target}]; kind is session, task, wiki or doc; target is the session id, the task id, the wiki page's absolute path or the doc's absolute path; line is worktree · status, #id · status, the wiki project or the doc's relative path.

errors.description: Sources that are not installed or failed: {id, error}.
